name: Off-Road Vehicle
description: A self-propelled vehicle in a prescribed class, motorcycles among them, ridden off the highway on Crown land; an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria ridden off-road is one.

restrictions.rule: The prescribed classes are all-terrain vehicles, motorcycles (two or three wheels or a track, ridden astride), off-road side-by-sides, snowmobiles and on-highway motor vehicles, each under 4,536 kg gross vehicle weight rating
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Regulation, B.C. Reg. 193/2015, ss. 1 and 2

restrictions.rule: No limit on motor power or speed; a motor assisted cycle is never one
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, S.B.C. 2014, c. 5, s. 1

restrictions.rule: Must be registered with ICBC and display its plate or sticker to ride on Crown land, unless it's already plated under the Motor Vehicle Act
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, S.B.C. 2014, c. 5, ss. 14 and 15

restrictions.rule: Rider and passenger must wear an off-road vehicle safety helmet on Crown land
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, S.B.C. 2014, c. 5, s. 18; Off-Road Vehicle Regulation, B.C. Reg. 193/2015, s. 21

restrictions.rule: Riders 15 or younger must meet the manufacturer's minimum age, height and weight and be supervised by an adult with a driver's licence or rider training; at 14 or 15 they may ride unsupervised with written parental consent
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Regulation, B.C. Reg. 193/2015, ss. 16 to 18

restrictions.rule: Riders 15 or younger may not carry a passenger other than their supervising adult
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Regulation, B.C. Reg. 193/2015, s. 19

restrictions.rule: Needs its required lights lit from half an hour after sunset to half an hour before sunrise
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, S.B.C. 2014, c. 5, s. 19; Off-Road Vehicle Regulation, B.C. Reg. 193/2015, s. 24

restrictions.rule: Not allowed on operating railway tracks, or on private land without the owner's or occupant's consent
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, S.B.C. 2014, c. 5, s. 17(2)

restrictions.rule: The Act doesn't apply on a highway, where it's a motor vehicle that must be registered, licensed and insured under the Motor Vehicle Act
restrictions.citation: Off-Road Vehicle Act, S.B.C. 2014, c. 5, s. 3; Motor Vehicle Act, R.S.B.C. 1996, c. 318, s. 3(1)
